ageVerification.title: Age verification
ageVerification.description: This application is strictly reserved for adults (18 years and older). By continuing, you confirm that you have reached the legal age.
ageVerification.denied: Access denied. You must be 18 or older to use this application.

onboarding.step1Description: Consent is a free, informed, explicit, and revocable agreement. It is given without pressure or coercion.
onboarding.step2Description: Create a consent, send an invitation, and both parties freely confirm. Everything is encrypted and confidential.
onboarding.step3Description: You can withdraw your consent at any time. This application does not replace the legal framework.

auth.magicLinkSent: A sign-in link has been sent to your email address.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

createConsent.title: New consent
createConsent.templateIntimate: I freely consent to a shared intimate moment with mutual respect.
createConsent.templateMassage: I freely consent to receiving/giving a massage in a caring setting.
createConsent.templatePhoto: I freely consent to being photographed within the agreed framework.
createConsent.templateDiscussion: I freely consent to an open and confidential discussion on a sensitive topic.
createConsent.templateActivity: I freely consent to participating in this activity under the defined conditions.
createConsent.errorInvalidStatement: The consent statement cannot be empty.
createConsent.errorMissingKeys: Encryption keys not found. Please sign in again.
createConsent.errorCreationFailed: Unable to create consent. Please try again.
createConsent.successMessage: Share this code with your partner so they can join the consent.
createConsent.shareMessage: Join my consent on Je Le Veux with the code: {{code}}

joinInvitation.title: Join an invitation
joinInvitation.subtitle: Enter the code you received or scan the QR code shared by the initiator.
joinInvitation.cameraPermissionDeniedMessage: You can enable camera access in settings, or enter the code manually.
joinInvitation.errorInvalidFormat: Invalid code format. Expected format is JLV-YYYY-XXXX-XXXX#key.
joinInvitation.errorNotFound: This invitation cannot be found. Check the code.
joinInvitation.errorAlreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used.
joinInvitation.errorDecryptFailed: Unable to decrypt the statement. The key is invalid.
joinInvitation.errorConsentNotPending: This consent is no longer awaiting a response.

invitation.title: Invitation received
invitation.unsureMessage: Take all the time you need. No pressure. The invitation remains valid for 24 hours.
invitation.disclaimer: By accepting, you confirm that you are exercising your free will. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
invitation.receiverPseudonymPlaceholder: Choose a pseudonym for this acceptance
invitation.errorAcceptFailed: Unable to accept. Please try again.
invitation.errorRefuseFailed: Unable to refuse. Please try again.

confirmation.title: Mutual consent established
confirmation.subtitle: Both parties have freely accepted.
confirmation.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw your consent? This action is immediate and irreversible.
confirmation.withdrawSuccess: Your consent has been withdrawn. The other party has been notified.
confirmation.statementUnavailable: Statement unavailable on this device. The local key is missing — sign in from the original device or keep the original shareCode.
confirmation.errorWithdrawFailed: Unable to withdraw. Please try again.
confirmation.errorNotActive: This consent is no longer active.
confirmation.errorNotParty: You are not a party to this consent.

resources.title: Resources and help
resources.whatIsConsentDesc: Consent is a free, informed, explicit, and revocable agreement. It must be given without pressure, coercion, or influence.
resources.legalFrameworkDesc: This application does not replace the legal framework in any way. It is a complementary tool to facilitate communication between adults.
resources.helplineDesc: If you or someone you know needs help: contact your local support services — RAINN (US), Refuge (UK), or local authorities.
resources.privacyDesc: Your data is encrypted end-to-end. No content is stored in plain text. You remain in control of your information.

profile.title: Profile
profile.deleteAccountConfirm: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted.

errors.generic: An error occurred. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.pseudonymInvalid: Pseudonym must be 3-30 characters (letters, numbers, _ and -).
errors.alreadyWithdrawn: This consent has already been withdrawn.
